text: Rename the variable `usr` to `user` in src/auth/login.ts.
Fix the typo 'recieve' in the README.
What does `git rebase --onto` do? One paragraph is fine.
Add a trailing newline to every .json file in config/.
Change the default port in server.ts from 3000 to 8080.
Remove the unused import of lodash in utils/format.ts.
Add an .editorconfig with 2-space indentation for this repo.
Bump the version in package.json from 1.4.2 to 1.4.3.
Show me which file defines the function `parseDuration`.
Convert this const object to a TypeScript enum: { A: 'a', B: 'b' }.
Add a GET /health endpoint to the Express app that returns the git sha and uptime, with a unit test.
Write unit tests for the `formatCurrency` helper covering negative values, rounding and unknown currency codes.
The date picker shows the wrong day in UTC+12 time zones. Find out why and fix it.
Refactor the UserService class: split the email-sending code into its own EmailService and update the callers.
Add pagination (limit/offset) to the /orders list endpoint and update the React table to use it.
Our CI fails on `npm test` only on Node 20. Investigate the failing test and fix it.
Add a dark mode toggle to the settings page that persists in localStorage.
Replace the hand-rolled debounce in the search box with a hook, and make sure unmounting cancels the pending call.
Add input validation with zod to the POST /signup handler and return RFC 7807 problem responses.
Write a migration that adds a nullable `archived_at` column to projects and backfills it from the deleted flag.
Design and implement a sharded job queue with at-least-once delivery, per-tenant fairness and retry with backoff. It must survive a worker crash mid-job without losing or double-running jobs.
Production intermittently double-charges customers. It happens roughly 1 in 5000 payments, only under load. Find the root cause across the checkout service, the webhook handler and the outbox worker.
Migrate our monolith's auth from server sessions to short-lived JWTs with refresh token rotation, across the API, web app, mobile app and admin, with zero downtime and a rollback plan.

Our Postgres query planner picks a sequential scan on a 400M-row table after the last vacuum. Diagnose from the attached EXPLAIN ANALYZE output, propose index and statistics changes, and prove they help without regressing writes.
Implement a CRDT-based collaborative text editor backend that supports offline edits, merges them deterministically and compacts history without breaking old clients.
Audit this multi-tenant API for authorization flaws: trace every route's tenant check, find IDOR and privilege escalation paths, and fix them with tests that prove each one is closed.
Rewrite the monorepo build so that incremental builds across 40 packages are correct under cyclic dev dependencies, and cache invalidation never serves stale output.
A memory leak grows the Node worker to 6 GB over 12 hours. Reproduce it, locate the retained objects in the heap snapshots across three services, and fix it without changing the public API.
Plan and execute splitting the payments module out of the monolith into its own service: define the boundary, data ownership, the dual-write migration, contract tests and the cutover steps.
Implement end-to-end encrypted family sharing: key hierarchy, device enrollment and revocation, key rotation when a member leaves, and a threat model that justifies each choice.
